title: Kindergarten Social Studies
description: Kindergarten students will build upon experiences with their families, schools, and communities as an introduction to social studies. The five disciplines of social studies will be addressed: culture, economics, geography, government and civics, and history.

practices.text: Gather information from a variety of sources, including: ● Printed materials (e.g., literary texts, newspapers, political cartoons, autobiographies, speeches, letters, personal journals) ● Graphic representations (e.g., maps, timelines, charts, artwork) ● Artifacts ● Media and technology sources ● Oral History

Critically examine a primary or secondary source in order to: ● Summarize significant ideas and relevant information ● Distinguish between fact and opinion ● Draw conclusions ● Recognize author’s purpose and point of view
Organize data from a variety of sources in order to: ● Compare and contrast two sources ● Recognize differences between two accounts ● Frame appropriate questions for further investigation
Communicate ideas supported by evidence to: ● Demonstrate an understanding of ideas ● Compare and contrast viewpoints ● Predict outcomes ● Illustrate cause and effect
Develop historical awareness by: ● Sequencing past, present, and future in chronological order ● Understanding that things change over time
Develop geographic awareness by: ● Identifying geographic symbols on maps and globes ● Understanding relationships between people, places, and resources
